title: Spell Out
summary: Shows a code or reference so it can be read aloud and copied correctly: grouped, look-alikes named, NATO spelling and hidden characters flagged.
description: Readable display for booking refs, wallet addresses, keys and passwords: grouped characters, look-alikes named under the glyph (0 zero vs O oh, 1/l/I, 5/S), NATO spelling with case when it matters, and Cyrillic look-alikes and invisible characters flagged.
catches: Non-Latin homoglyphs (Cyrillic, Greek) posing as Latin letters
Case that matters, spoken as capital/lowercase
Copying the exact value instead of the grouped display
limits: Look-alike list is a common set, not exhaustive
Secret mode masks visually; the value is still in the page
a11y: View switch uses aria-pressed buttons in a labelled group
Groups are a list; each has its spoken spelling for screen readers
Hidden values announce a hidden label; reveal is an aria-pressed toggle
Copy result and warnings render in polite live regions
stops: Booking ref misread over the phone
